verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh man bach kram ikatr bhe paramadhabhut gat alakh lakhaae hai ||

en.bdb: The obedient slaves of Guru, being dyed in the hue of Naam Simran (with their mind, speech and actions being harmonious) sees the astonishing and transcendental Lord God conspicuous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)tar dhiaan dhib jot ko udhot bhio tirabhavan roop ghaT a(n)tar dhikhaae hai ||

en.bdb: And when he looks inward (concentrates his faculties within), he sees the divine light refulgent within. He sees the happenings of the three worlds in his consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਤਨ ਜਤਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: param nidhaan gur giaan ko pragaas bhio ga(n)mitaa tirakaal gat jatan jataae hai ||

en.bdb: When the supreme treasure of Guru's Gyan (Divine knowledge) becomes effulgent in the mind of a Guru conscious person, he becomes aware of all the three worlds. And even then, he does not go astray from his objective of absorption of self into the vastness of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮਧ ਪਾਨ ਮਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੬੪॥
verses.translit_en: aatam tara(n)g prem ras madh paan mat akath kathaa binodh herat hiraae hai ||64||

en.bdb: Such a devotee remains in a state of trance drinking deep the divine elixir of ecstasy. This wonderful state is beyond description. One feels amazed at this state. (64)
